record.question: How many languages were initially included in the Indian Constitution?
record.explanation: The original Eighth Schedule contained 14 languages. Later additions brought the number to 22, so “initially” rules out using the later total. A Government of India release dated 18 December 2024 explicitly distinguishes these counts and records the subsequent additions. Reference: https://www.coal.nic.in/sites/default/files/2024-12/PIB2085529.pdf#page=2 . This is an unofficial explanation for the recovered reproduction, not an examiner key.
